top.title: Mumford & Sons / Chris Stapleton Live Performance
top.description: Clip the live performance of Mumford & Sons and Chris Stapleton from the approved folder. Every clip should show that this crossover sounds even better live.
top.brief: "Here" is a moving duet from Mumford & Sons and Chris Stapleton, performed live at The 60th Annual CMA Awards in November 2026. Built around honest lyrics about pride, mistakes, and wanting to belong, the song stands out for its emotional weight and how naturally it brings folk rock and soul-country together. Mumford & Sons is a British folk-rock band from London that broke through globally with banjo-driven anthems like "Little Lion Man," "I Will Wait," and "The Cave." Known for big emotional builds, sing-along choruses, and a GRAMMY-winning album with Babel, they have a knack for turning honest lyrics into huge crowd moments. Chris Stapleton is a Kentucky country and soul singer-songwriter famous for his rich, raspy voice and deep-cut storytelling. Before stepping into the spotlight with hit albums like Traveller and songs like "Tennessee Whiskey" and "Starting Over," he built a huge name behind the scenes writing hit songs for other artists. Mumford & Sons made their CMA Awards debut alongside Chris Stapleton at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville on November 18, 2026, bringing a British folk-rock band and one of Nashville's strongest voices onto country music's biggest stage. #mumfordandsons #chrisstapleton #cmas #performance "Here" is a moving duet from Mumford & Sons and Chris Stapleton, performed live at The 60th Annual CMA Awards in November 2026.
